title: SPECIAL TIME-BASED PROVISIONS
previewText: The modifications to time limits associated with this Resolution and set forth in this Section, inclusive, may be applied to zoning lots within designated recovery areas, as set forth in Section 65-01 (Applicability of Article VI, Chapter 5).
